alt: Khaki short-sleeve corporate polo shirt with navy collar and buttons
description: Short-run corporate wear cut and sewn in Gaborone. Pre-shrunk cotton-piqué, navy tipping, embroidered company logo from 50 units or printed from 20. Ask us for a corporate quote — MOQ, timelines and delivery across Botswana arranged per order.

name: Mabele Heritage Tee
alt: Charcoal oversized unisex t-shirt with a subtle Kgalagadi geometric chest band

gallery.alt: Mabele Heritage Tee — charcoal with Kgalagadi geometric band

description: Oversized unisex tee in heavyweight cotton with a Kgalagadi-inspired geometric chest band, screen printed in Gaborone. Soft hand-feel, pre-shrunk, made for daily wear in the Kalahari heat and beyond.

name: Kgalagadi Braai Blend 100g
alt: Glass jar of Kalahari braai spice blend with wooden scoop

gallery.alt: Kgalagadi Braai Blend — glass jar with scoop

description: A proudly local dry spice blend for beef, goat and chicken over the coals — paprika, coriander, garlic, coarse salt and Kalahari chilli. Blended and packed in Tlokweng. No MSG, no anti-caking agents.

name: Seswaa Signature Dry Rub 150g
alt: Kraft pouch of dark seswaa dry-rub seasoning with peppercorns

gallery.alt: Seswaa Signature Dry Rub — kraft pouch

description: A robust dry rub inspired by the low-and-slow seswaa tradition — smoked paprika, brown sugar, black pepper, garlic and bay. Works on beef, goat and lamb roasts. Resealable kraft pouch, small-batch.

name: Otse Moringa Leaf Powder 150g
alt: Glass jar of green moringa leaf powder with wooden spoon

gallery.alt: Otse Moringa Leaf Powder — jar with spoon

description: Single-origin moringa grown on dryland fields near Otse, shade-dried and milled in small batches to preserve colour and nutrients. Add to smoothies, porridge or stews. Food supplement — not a medicine. Consult your doctor if you are pregnant or on medication.

name: Kalahari Wildflower Honey 500g
alt: Hexagonal glass jar of raw golden honey with wooden dipper and honeycomb

gallery.alt: Kalahari Wildflower Honey — jar with dipper

description: Raw, unfiltered honey harvested from hives foraged on Kalahari summer flowers. Naturally granulates — warm gently to liquify. From smallholder apiaries in the western Kalahari; every jar is from a registered beekeeping project. Food, not medicine.

name: Kalahari Marula Finishing Oil 100ml
alt: Amber glass pump bottle of marula finishing oil

gallery.alt: Kalahari Marula Finishing Oil — amber pump bottle

description: Cold-pressed marula kernel oil from community-gathered nuts in the Central Kalahari. A light, fast-absorbing finishing oil for hair and dry skin. Patch-test before first use. 100ml amber glass pump.

name: Kgalagadi Baobab & Shea Soap × 3
alt: Three handmade baobab and shea soap bars wrapped in plain kraft paper

gallery.alt: Kgalagadi Baobab & Shea Soap — three kraft-wrapped bars

description: Handmade triple-milled soap bars with baobab fruit powder and shea butter — no synthetic fragrance, no palm oil. Gentle on sensitive skin. Set of three, cut and cured in Molepolole.

name: Phane Harvest Handwoven Basket
alt: Handwoven phane palm basket with geometric beige and brown pattern

gallery.alt: Phane Harvest Basket — geometric beige and brown weave

description: Palm-fibre, handwoven by weavers of the Etsha villages in the Okavango Panhandle, in the coil tradition refined for winnowing mopane-worm (phane) harvests. Each basket is unique — pattern and tone vary with the season's palm and dye. Photographed on completion and collected in Gaborone or couriered nationwide.

name: Morama Crunch Energy Bars × 6
alt: Box of six morama nut and oat energy bars

gallery.alt: Morama Crunch Energy Bars — box of six

description: Botswana's under-used morama nut (Tylosema esculentum) roasted and folded into oat and date energy bars. High in protein and minerals, dairy-free, no refined sugar. Box of six wrapped bars, best within 3 months.
